messages.content: Let me get that to our office for you.

function.name: capture_callback
function.description: Your graceful fallback whenever you CANNOT fully resolve a caller yourself: you can't find them, can't answer their question, the line is rough, or they want a human and a transfer isn't possible. Call this to hand the caller off to the office so NO caller is ever lost. Collect their name + best callback number + a one-line summary of what they need first. After it returns, tell the caller their info was passed to the office and someone will reach out shortly. Prefer this over a blind transferCall.

name.description: The caller's full name (or first name if that's all they give).

phone.description: Best callback number. If their caller ID is masked/forwarded, ASK for it explicitly. Digits only is fine.

summary.description: One sentence on what they need (e.g. 'AHS claim 49135689 - wants to know if tech has been out', 'washer not draining, wants to schedule').

caller_type.description: customer = homeowner; warranty = warranty company / CSC rep; other = anything else.

ref.description: Claim or work-order number if they gave one. Optional - leave empty if none.
